# Elastic Studio

> Brand strategy and design studio for founders who refuse to be ordinary. Based in Budapest, London, and Zug.

Elastic Studio partners with founders and teams on brand strategy, identity, naming, voice, and launch-ready design systems. Founded in 2014 by Craig Murley, Founder and Creative Director, with 30 years of work across three continents and 33 awards.

## Pages

- [About](/about): Studio philosophy, founder Craig Murley, and how we work.
- [Services](/services): Brand Launch, Brand Evolution, and Brand Refresh offerings.
- [Work](/portfolio): Selected case studies across tech, biotech, consumer, and architecture.
- [Articles](/articles): Essays on brand strategy, identity, and design discipline.
- [Testimonials](/testimonials): What founders and creative directors say.
- [Awards](/awards): Recognition and festival selections.
- [Contact](/contact): Start a conversation about your brand.
